yaml:
apiVersion: unified-cd/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: edge-w4-longpod
spec:
  agentSelector:
    - kind:kubernetes
  podTemplate:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: job
          image: alpine:3.20
  steps:
    - name: tick
      run: |
        echo "W4-LONGPOD-BEGIN $(hostname)"
        i=0
        while [ $i -lt 120 ]; do
          echo "W4-LONGPOD-TICK $i"
          i=$((i+1))
          sleep 1
        done
        echo "W4-LONGPOD-END"
